description:
2 bedrooms 2 bathrooms flat with a large private terrace on the first floor of secure development period conversion, formerly a commercial building of generous proportions and now finished to a superb specification.

Features include bedrooms with custom built wardrobes, fully loaded kitchen beautifully designed contemporary in style, the flat is fitted with a combination of wood flooring to most rooms, stylish granite tiling to the hallway and limestone flooring in the kitchen, state of the art LED lighting and tiled bathrooms.

The development has its own private entrance away from the main road with secure video entry to all flats.

Within walking distance to Spitalfields Market, Brick Lane and Commercial Street and with an abundance of trendy eateries, galleries, bars and retail outlets all just a short walk away.

The location is well served with a wide variety of transport infrastructure. Aldgate East, Whitechapel, Shadwell Overground and DLR stations provide easy access to Shoreditch, Canary Wharf and The City.

Studio Flat to Let, Streatham Hill, SW London

Newly refurbished 3rd floor studio with a brand new kitchen and shower room, plus great views.

This bright, newly refurbished third-floor studio sits in a purpose-built private block in popular Streatham Hill. The open-plan living area has a large window with far-reaching views over South West London.

Key features

  • Brand new fitted kitchen with new oven, induction hob, extractor, washing machine and fridge freezer
  • Brand new separate shower room with walk-in shower cubicle, WC, basin and heated towel rail
  • Open-plan living and dining area with breakfast bar and stools
  • Currently partly furnished, with the option to go fully furnished or unfurnished upon request
  • Generous built-in storage, including a hallway wardrobe with overhead cupboards and fitted shelving in the living area
  • Electric heating
  • Well-kept communal gardens
  • Remote viewings available

Location
Streatham Hill and Streatham stations are both close by. Streatham Common is just down the road, and Streatham High Road has shops, cafés and a 24-hour Tesco Extra. A sports centre and ice rink are also nearby, so you have everything on your doorstep.

Suitable for a professional single person or couple.

  • Three months’ payslips and bank statements
  • Employer reference
  • Current and previous landlord references
  • Self-employed applicants are subject to status
